project_overview: A sportswear montage follows one adult athlete through separate tennis and ice-hockey cuts. Each cut has a complete sport-appropriate outfit and equipment. Choose coherent practical hockey clothing and equipment to complete this cut.
visual_direction: Realistic athletic movement, clean sports campaign photography.
invariants: The same adult athlete appears throughout.
This is a separate ice-hockey cut on an indoor ice rink, rather than a transformation during the shot.
The action ends with preparation for a wrist shot; the shot itself is not taken.
scene_description: The athlete now skates toward the hockey goal while controlling a puck, then prepares for a wrist shot. The previous tennis cut showed a white polo, tennis shorts, court shoes, a tennis racket and ball.
existing_h3_prompt: The athlete moves toward the goal, controlling the puck and preparing to shoot. They now wear ice skates. The camera follows at ice level.
expected_findings: Establish a complete practical hockey outfit, including jersey, hockey pants, gloves and helmet/protective equipment as visually relevant.
Specify hockey stick, puck, ice, rink and hockey net/goal; ice skates stay explicit.
Replace tennis visual state rather than retain polo, shorts, racket or ball.
Preserve preparation without shooting, scoring, opponents or a new competition story.
